name: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Payments
description: Managed micropayments capability within Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, GA in August 2026.
descriptionZh: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 内的托管微支付能力，2026 年 8 月 GA。
keyFact: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Payments reached general availability on 18 August 2026, giving agents managed micropayments (often under $1) via Coinbase and Stripe/Privy wallets with x402 support; GA added the Machine Payment Protocol (MPP) co-drafted by Stripe and Tempo, plus payment sessions with spend caps.
keyFactZh: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Payments 于 2026 年 8 月 18 日正式 GA，通过 Coinbase 与 Stripe/Privy 钱包为 Agent 提供托管微支付（常低于 1 美元）并支持 x402；GA 时新增了由 Stripe 与 Tempo 共同起草的 Machine Payment Protocol（MPP），以及带花费上限的支付会话。
